messages:
julia_ml: Nightly eval alert: customer_vignettes pass@1 dropped ~12% for rw-3b-quantized compared to last week. Dashboard shows a shift in sampling stats (temp/top_p distribution). Did anyone change defaults?

sam_w: I merged a change yesterday to increase exploration on quantized models — set default temp to 0.95 for qmodels in the serving layer. The PR said it was opt-in via config but I might have left it as a fallback. cc @julia_ml

eva_research: Ooh that could explain it. The prompt set is sensitive to temperature — higher temp yields more varied completions, hurting pass@1. Do we have the run config for the nightly job?

eval-bot: nightly-eval finished: model=rw-3b-quantized run_id=20260318-11 metrics: pass@1=-12.4%, avg_logprob_delta=-0.28. Sampling params logged: {"temperature":0.95,"top_p":0.92,"top_k":40,"seed":null} (see /runs/20260318-11)

ben_infra: Quick note: seed=null means per-request nondeterministic seeding. Also recent change in batching code re-seeds per-shard for parallel workers (PR #842). That could amplify variance when combined with higher temp.

julia_ml: So two changes (temp bump + per-shard seeding) might interact. Can we reproduce deterministically by replaying the failing requests with pinned seed and old temp?

luka_repro: I'll run a replay on /runs/20260318-11 with: 

```bash
python tools/replay.py --run 20260318-11 --model rw-3b-quantized --seed 42 --temperature 0.7 --top_p 0.9
```

and compare outputs. If pass@1 recovers -> confirms sampling param drift.

eva_research: Also check quantization path: some quant kernels had a small nondeterministic op (rounding variance) in PR #801. That alone didn't show in unit tests, but combined with different sampling could push outputs across metric thresholds.

sam_w: I'll open an immediate rollback for the default temp change (revert PR #859) and pin the nightly job to env var REDWOOD_NIGHTLY_TEMP=0.7 until we fully triage.

ben_infra: I'll also revert the per-shard reseed behavior to previous global-worker-seed mode in infra queue, and schedule a canary replay.

luka_repro: Replay results so far (first 200 prompts): with seed=42 & temp=0.7 pass@1 matches baseline within noise. With seed null & temp=0.95 failures reproduced. Looks like the temp bump is the primary driver; reseed increases variance magnitude. I'll paste sample mismatches in the thread.

julia_ml: Good. Let's document the root cause as config drift (default temp change) + infra-level reseeding amplifying variance. Action items: 1) revert default temp change (sam_w) 2) revert per-shard reseed (ben_infra) 3) add deterministic nightly flag (--seed) for canary replays (luka_repro) 4) add a gating eval that compares sampling stat distributions before accepting default config changes (eva_research).

eva_research: I'll author a small eval that checks KL divergence of token distribution and pass@1 delta for the top 5 prompt sets when sampling params change. Make it a presubmit for serving config PRs.

sam_w: Revert PR #859 in progress, will push hotfix by EOD and set REDWOOD_NIGHTLY_TEMP env on nightly job.

ben_infra: Reverting reseed behavior as well, pushing PR #873 -> staging. Also adding logs for per-request seed assignment so future regressions are easier to trace.

julia_ml: Thanks team. Luka, after you finish full-run replays, paste a small summary (counts + examples) and we'll close the loop. We'll keep nightly pinned until the gating eval is in.

luka_repro: Will do — running full job now; ETA ~30m.

julia_ml: Marking this one as owner=eng-ml, severity=medium, followup: gating-eval + config-presubmit. :thumbsup:
